finding: Immediate skin-to-skin contact (ISSC) and early breastfeeding during cesarean section reduce maternal oxidative stress.
mod_finding: The study examined the effect of immediate skin-to-skin contact (ISSC) and early breastfeeding during cesarean section on maternal oxidative stress and postoperative pain.
